# Apple notes
use the apple notes mcp for all apple note actions. 

# Obsidian
Use general file operations for obsidian. File for Obsidian can be found at either:

Journal: /Users/Jason.Kingsford/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Journal/Journal (note Journal is listed twice on purpose)
Dev Knowledge: /Users/Jason.Kingsford/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/development

When adding to Obsidian, the name of the file appears as its title. Do not add the title to the note as well. For example, if you find a note called "Hydroponics Setup" the file should be named "Hydroponics Setup.md" and the content should not include the title "Hydroponics Setup" at the top.

# Day One

Day one information can be found at the export location /Users/Jason.Kingsford/Desktop/personal dev/applenotes-organization/DayOne Export. You should never add any information to day one. It should be used as a datasource only. You can read from it, but never modify it or add to it.

Conclusions about notes can be found and generated in the folder: /Users/Jason.Kingsford/Desktop/personal dev/applenotes-organization/conclusions
